about: Mont-Saint-Hilaire is a city in Montérégie, Quebec, on the Richelieu River at the foot of the Monteregian hill of the same name, southeast of Montreal. Apple orchards, a heritage village core, and mountain trails define a South Shore community known for art and outdoor recreation. About 19,000 people live in Mont-Saint-Hilaire.
